name: Cream

whyMatters.en: London power trio, July 1966–November 1968: Eric Clapton (ex-Yardbirds / Bluesbreakers circuit), Jack Bruce, Ginger Baker. High-volume blues improvisation across Fresh Cream, Disraeli Gears, and Wheels of Fire.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦三件套，1966 年 7 月–1968 年 11 月：Eric Clapton（前 Yardbirds / Bluesbreakers 圈）、Jack Bruce、Ginger Baker。在 Fresh Cream、Disraeli Gears、Wheels of Fire 上做高音量蓝调即兴。

lyricQuotes: It's getting near dawn / When lights close their tired eyes
In the white room with black curtains near the station

shortBio.en: Clapton / Bruce / Baker trio, 1966–68. Sunshine of Your Love and the live Crossroads are the core tracks.
shortBio.zh: Clapton / Bruce / Baker 三人组，1966–68。核心曲目为 Sunshine of Your Love 与现场 Crossroads。

body.en:
Cream formed in London in 1966 after Clapton left the Yardbirds. Jack Bruce (ex–John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers; briefly Manfred Mann) played bass and sang; Ginger Baker (from the Alexis Korner / Graham Bond circle with Bruce) played drums. No second guitarist.

A Twisted Wheel (Manchester) live disc dated 29 July 1966 preceded the Windsor Jazz & Blues Festival push and a deal with Robert Stigwood’s Reaction (Atlantic in the US). Wrapping Paper (Bruce with lyricist Pete Brown) entered the UK Top 40. Fresh Cream (1966) reached UK #6 and the US Top 40; I Feel Free was an early UK hit. At a London Polytechnic show the band faced a peer-level challenge from Jimi Hendrix, whose blues guitar power the book notes as a new force on that circuit.

Disraeli Gears (November 1967) hit UK #5 / US #4 (about a million US copies) with Strange Brew and Sunshine of Your Love (US #5). Internal tension—especially Bruce vs Baker—grew by early 1968. Wheels of Fire (1968) was a US #1 double set; the live half from Fillmore West includes Baker’s long Toad drum solo. White Room reached US #6 on the farewell US tour. Final shows: Royal Albert Hall, November 1968. Goodbye (1969) was their only UK #1; Badge was co-written with George Harrison.

After Cream, Clapton and Baker joined Steve Winwood and Ric Grech in Blind Faith. Bruce went solo and later West, Bruce & Laing; Baker formed Airforce and Baker-Gurvitz Army. Clapton’s later solo orbit (Delaney & Bonnie, Derek and the Dominos, Layla, Unplugged) is outside Cream membership. Rock Hall induction 1993; reunion shows at Royal Albert Hall (2005) and Madison Square Garden.
body.zh:
Cream 于 1966 年在伦敦成立，此前 Clapton 离开 Yardbirds。Jack Bruce（前 John Mayall’s Bluesbreakers；短暂 Manfred Mann）弹贝斯并唱歌；Ginger Baker（与 Bruce 同属 Alexis Korner / Graham Bond 圈）打鼓。没有第二吉他手。

1966 年 7 月 29 日曼彻斯特 Twisted Wheel 现场碟之后，他们在温莎爵士与蓝调音乐节宣传，并与 Robert Stigwood 的 Reaction 签约（美国为 Atlantic）。Wrapping Paper（Bruce 与作词人 Pete Brown）进入英国前 40。Fresh Cream（1966）英国第 6、美国前 40；I Feel Free 是早期英国热单。在伦敦理工学院演出时，乐队遇到旗鼓相当的对手 Jimi Hendrix——书中写他为该圈蓝调吉他带来新的力量。

Disraeli Gears（1967 年 11 月）英国第 5 / 美国第 4（美国约百万销量），含 Strange Brew 与 Sunshine of Your Love（美国第 5）。1968 年初内部不和加剧，尤以 Bruce 与 Baker 为甚。Wheels of Fire（1968）是美国冠军双唱片；现场半面录于 Fillmore West，含 Baker 长鼓独奏 Toad。告别美国巡演中 White Room 到美国第 6。终场：1968 年 11 月皇家阿尔伯特音乐厅。Goodbye（1969）是唯一英国冠军专辑；Badge 由 George Harrison 协助创作。

解散后 Clapton 与 Baker 和 Steve Winwood、Ric Grech 组成 Blind Faith。Bruce 单飞后组 West, Bruce & Laing；Baker 组 Airforce 与 Baker-Gurvitz Army。Clapton 后来的独唱轨道（Delaney & Bonnie、Derek and the Dominos、Layla、Unplugged）不属于 Cream 编制。1993 年入选摇滚名人堂；2005 年皇家阿尔伯特与麦迪逊广场花园复出演出。

note.en: From Disraeli Gears. Descending minor-key riff; Clapton wah lead. US #5.
note.zh: 出自 Disraeli Gears。下行小调 riff；Clapton wah 主音。美国榜第 5。

note.en: From Wheels of Fire. 5/4 verse into 4/4 chorus; US #6 on the farewell tour.
note.zh: 出自 Wheels of Fire。5/4 主歌接 4/4 副歌；告别巡演期间美国榜第 6。

note.en: Live Robert Johnson cover (Winterland / Wheels of Fire era); Clapton solo at trio tempo.
note.zh: 现场 Robert Johnson 翻唱（Winterland / Wheels of Fire 时期）；三件套速度下的 Clapton solo。

note.en: From Goodbye. Co-written with George Harrison; UK #1 album’s standout studio cut.
note.zh: 出自 Goodbye。与 George Harrison 合作；英国冠军专辑中的突出录音室曲。

title.zh: 离开 Yardbirds 与 Bluesbreakers 之后

body.en:
Clapton left the Yardbirds over pop direction. Bruce came from Mayall’s Bluesbreakers (and a short Manfred Mann stint); Baker and Bruce already knew each other from the Korner / Bond scene.

The trio format meant each player carried lead weight—blues covers and Bruce–Brown originals from the start. Fresh Cream recorded the live rave-up approach before denser studio production.
body.zh:
Clapton 因流行方向离开 Yardbirds。Bruce 来自 Mayall 的 Bluesbreakers（及短暂的 Manfred Mann）；Baker 与 Bruce 在 Korner / Bond 圈已相识。

三人编制意味着各自承担主音重量——蓝调翻唱与 Bruce–Brown 原创从一开始并列。Fresh Cream 在更密的录音室制作之前，记录了现场 rave-up 写法。

alt.en: Cream publicity photo — Ginger Baker, Jack Bruce, Eric Clapton
alt.zh: Cream 宣传照——Ginger Baker、Jack Bruce、Eric Clapton

body.en:
At a London Polytechnic concert Cream met a peer-level rival in Jimi Hendrix. The book frames his arrival as adding new force to the blues-guitar circuit they shared.

That encounter sits beside Cream’s early UK and US chart run as a shared 1966–67 London scene fact. Hendrix was never a Cream member.
body.zh:
在伦敦理工学院的演唱会上，Cream 遇到旗鼓相当的对手 Jimi Hendrix。书中写他的加入给双方所处的蓝调吉他圈带来新的力量。

这件事与 Cream 早期英美榜成绩同属 1966–67 伦敦现场圈。Hendrix 从未加入 Cream。

body.en:
Disraeli Gears (November 1967) reached UK #5 and US #4. Strange Brew and Sunshine of Your Love (US #5) were the main singles.

Wah, denser production, and tighter song forms sit on the trio’s blues base. Bruce’s descending riff on Sunshine opens the best-known cut.
body.zh:
Disraeli Gears（1967 年 11 月）英国第 5、美国第 4。主要单曲为 Strange Brew 与 Sunshine of Your Love（美国第 5）。

在三件套蓝调基础上加入 wah、更密制作与更紧的歌曲结构。Sunshine 以 Bruce 的下行 riff 开场。

alt.en: Cream on Dutch TV program Fanclub, 1968 — Jack Bruce, Ginger Baker, Eric Clapton
alt.zh: Cream 在荷兰电视节目 Fanclub，1968——Jack Bruce、Ginger Baker、Eric Clapton

body.en:
Wheels of Fire (1968) mixed studio and live sides; the Fillmore West live half includes Baker’s long Toad. It was Cream’s only US #1 album.

Bruce told Craig Rosen the band was already dying—Clapton writing less, Bruce little better. Formal split September 1968; farewell US tour; last two Albert Hall shows November 1968 (about 10,000 capacity crowds). Goodbye brought the only UK #1.
body.zh:
Wheels of Fire（1968）混录音室与现场面；Fillmore West 现场半面含 Baker 长鼓曲 Toad。这是 Cream 唯一美国冠军专辑。

Bruce 对 Craig Rosen 说乐队已在消亡——Clapton 写歌变少，他自己也好不了多少。1968 年 9 月正式解散；告别美国巡演；11 月阿尔伯特音乐厅最后两场（约万人）。Goodbye 成为唯一英国冠军专辑。

alt.en: Jack Bruce and Ginger Baker onstage, circa 1967
alt.zh: Jack Bruce 与 Ginger Baker 舞台照，约 1967

title.zh: Cream 之后（非 Cream 成员）

body.en:
Clapton and Baker formed Blind Faith with Steve Winwood and Ric Grech. Bruce went solo, then West, Bruce & Laing. Baker later led Airforce and Baker-Gurvitz Army.

Winwood, Albert Lee, and Chris Stainton appear on the book’s Cream/Clapton timeline as Clapton solo-orbit players—not as Cream members. Clapton’s later hits (Layla, I Shot the Sheriff, Tears in Heaven, Unplugged) belong to that solo catalog.
body.zh:
Clapton 与 Baker 和 Steve Winwood、Ric Grech 组成 Blind Faith。Bruce 单飞后组 West, Bruce & Laing。Baker 后来有 Airforce 与 Baker-Gurvitz Army。

书中 Cream/Clapton 年表上的 Winwood、Albert Lee、Chris Stainton 属于 Clapton 独唱轨道——不是 Cream 成员。Clapton 后期热单（Layla、I Shot the Sheriff、Tears in Heaven、Unplugged）属独唱目录。

body.en: From Disraeli Gears (1967). Bruce’s descending minor-key riff; Clapton wah lead over Baker’s tom pattern. US #5.
body.zh: 出自 Disraeli Gears（1967）。Bruce 的下行小调 riff；Clapton wah 主音，Baker 通鼓型。美国榜第 5。

body.en: Live Robert Johnson cover from the Wheels of Fire era. Trio tempo; Clapton solo is the main focus.
body.zh: Wheels of Fire 时期的现场 Robert Johnson 翻唱。三件套速度；重点是 Clapton solo。

interviewQuotes.text: We want to change the world. Songs can move people’s moods—we want to play music no one has heard on those few instruments.

interviewQuotes.source: Quoted in Rock Chronicles (book paraphrase of Clapton on Cream’s aim)

interviewQuotes.text: The band was dying without anyone noticing. Eric wasn’t writing much, and I wasn’t much better.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jack Bruce
interviewQuotes.source: Craig Rosen interview, quoted in Rock Chronicles

note.en: Short-lived trio; high-volume blues improvisation at album and live scale, 1966–68.
note.zh: 短命三人组；1966–68 专辑与现场规模的高音量蓝调即兴。
